caption: The drawing depicts a single ornamental pedestal or vase centered on a light, neutral background. The object is rendered in shades of beige, brown, and light tan, giving it a monochromatic appearance. The top is wide and circular with a scalloped, decorative rim featuring rounded, bead-like details along the edge. Below the rim, the body of the vase or pedestal has a vertically ribbed texture, with each rib gently curved and narrowing as they descend. The central section transitions smoothly into a narrower, flared base that widens out at the bottom into a circular foot. The shading on the object indicates a light source from the upper left, creating subtle highlights and shadows along the contours. In the bottom right corner of the image, the name "Annie B. Johnston." is signed in small cursive script. The entire composition is framed by a faint rectangular line, centered on the page.
title: Pottery Vase
